mentions.name: Antics
mentions.description: Antics is a site for playing multiplayer browser games with friends and for making your own games using its MCP integration. The bet is that current AI models can one-shot a fun browser game but can't generate the multiplayer part, so Antics provides that missing piece: a browser SDK plus a hosted relay handling the server, WebSockets, state sync, and hosting. You deploy a game and get one link, and everyone who opens it is in the same room.
mentions.problem: AI models can one-shot a fun single-player browser game, but they can't generate the multiplayer part — the server, WebSockets, state sync, and hosting.
mentions.audience: Anyone who wants to play multiplayer browser games with friends, and anyone who wants to one-shot their own fun browser game using AI models
mentions.source_excerpt:
Antics (https://antics.gg): a site to play silly little multiplayer games with friends, and to make your own by using our MCP

The bet is that current models are good enough that anyone can one-shot a fun browser game. What they can't generate is the multiplayer part (server, WebSockets, state sync, hosting), so that's the only part we've built: a browser SDK plus a hosted relay. Deploy a game, get one link, and everyone who opens it is in the same room.
